title: Unified architecture risk register
summary: Known ways the migration can appear successful while preserving the original problem.

risks.risk: Bulk rewrite recreates undocumented behavior and loses working UX.
risks.mitigation: One accepted vertical slice, then bounded route groups.

risks.risk: New pipeline is added while old projectors remain active.
risks.mitigation: Call-path mapping, coverage metric and final zero-reference deletion gate.

risks.risk: Public prose moves from one hidden array to another.
Single-page build becomes a second renderer.
risks.mitigation: One PageBuilder and semantic parity test.
Framework-first classification and immutable lock updates.

risks.risk: Long chat history overrides the accepted contract.
risks.mitigation: New task starts from committed spec, graph and handoff; chat is evidence only.

risks.risk: Passing unit tests are misreported as release readiness.
risks.mitigation: Separate architecture, consumer, release and production gates with explicit nonclaims.
